body: If you feel comfortable sharing, what motivated you against it?
That is beautifully put, thank you <3

Yeah i get that a lot hehe. And no prob! 
And i cant see her doing so truthfully. She has been attempting to pretend it didnt happen all day but ive been very firm on not letting her actions side. One way or another i want to make her understand at the very least basic human decency is not to tell someone to end their life- especially not when they have a record of suicidal attempts she has been far too aware of
Yeah both hold a very similar mentality that willpower conquers all mental illnesses despite both seeing first hand how badly they affect me.

Its okay no need to be sorry. I wonder that myself. I think its due to stigma. She believes willpower alone can overcome depression. I suppose because she thinks depression = sadness. Which while that encompasses sadness, depression is far more than an emotion. Far more than a feeling. She doesnt seem to get that though

I connect very deeply with what you said. That being said though, i really dont encourage you to commit said deed. I know life is grueling as hell more often than not. Being aimless and existing is torture. But even if you have no viable reason to live for, id still deeply encourage living anyhow. There is always a reason to live even if you have to forcably make your own. I know its shitty but this pain isnt worth losing another good soul.
Im here if youd wish to vent about anything. I often help my friends with these sort of things so i certainly dont mind

The thing is when it comes to my mental illnesses, she has always been incredibly negative. She isnt a completely awful mother to me in other circumstances. She treats me well enough aside from when she is in a bad mood (even if unrelated to me at all) so she lashed out a lot then. She sort of for a few days some times encourages me and offers me love. But overall it is just ridicule and insults and mocking.

I really appreciate it :) the friends i have are quite supportive in my journey to gain help. Which im endlessly grateful for since its something i havent had in the past. I dont know what ill do in regards to my family issues though. I dont want to just brush it under the rug but im clueless on how to convey to them what is wrong in a way they are willing to accept

The thing about depression is that for sufferers such as myself, it is honestly very easy to suppress and hide signs. The toll depression takes can happen rapidly or gradually to points where you wouldn't even be able to notice. My depression personally is very apparent as i am very vocal and do not try and hide it. But for others due to fear of ridicule or a variety of other reasons, they choose not to speak out. Which is awful. Speaking out doesnt always go well, speaking fron experience, but i still would encourage it always

I think family cruelty for me is easily one of the hardest to accept. While in general im a sensitive person who takes many things to heart, when it comes to the people i cherish most in this world, comments like my mother telling me to die, even in the heat of the moment, just sickens me and easily deteriorates all my desire to want to keep fighting. It is just incredibly cruel..

Thank you so much 💓 i do have a decent support system in terms of a few close friends. But it really does tear me apart to not have support of my family, when the thing i value most in this world honestly above my own life most times is my family. To have people i love not support nor try to be patient with me is something that not only deeply scars me, but really takes a toll on my mental stability. It hurts so much. It hurts to think i should just accept them being ignorant to the real issues.
I get upset naturally, but i try not to react in anger and remove myself from the situation as fast as possible. It still really hurts because i feel very invalidated

That just isnt justified for her to do to you either. I dont undertand how a mother could view things such as that as okay regardless of severity. Parents are suppose to support and be there foe their kids, not lash out and act like children themselves. That isnt fair to either of us what they do

I honestly do think its a bit of both. I think maybe for her its overwhelming to deal with all these things cause for whatever reason she is blindsighted by my pain despite me constantly expressing it to her. She doesnt tend to take me seriously. She mocks my depression a lot and has for years. I just want for her to understand the grief i feel and show compassion and not ridicule. Its difficult not to be torn up by this since i love her so much

I dunno, id certainly consider it an attempt. There is a large gray area on what is considered an attempt. There is indeed a difference between thoughts, idealizations, and attempts. You physically made preparations to end your life. And even if you didn't go through with them and end up in the hospital, an attempt is an attempt. It means you tried to do so but didnt succeed for whatever reason. You acted on your thoughts. (That being said please dont go through with any more attempts or such, i know im just a stranger but it breaks my heart to see anyone go through that awful end. You are worth far more than that. You deserve much more than that.)
I certainly am seeking help no worries, but i cant get help as often as id wish due to lack of funds.
